name: Eötvös Loránd University
summary: Budapest university with a Szombathely campus: fourteen English-taught bachelor's degrees from informatics and chemistry to economics and education.

ib.text: The IB Diploma counts as your secondary certificate (ELTE wants it equivalent to the Hungarian matriculation). English B2, or an English-medium school certificate; economics degrees encourage IB results.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Three-year English-language psychology degree: theoretical foundations and basic methods, behavioural measurement and experiments, and applied branches, qualifying you for psychology master's degrees (180 ECTS).
programmes.overview: The course is built on four core subfields: cognitive and affective psychology (memory, perception, emotion), personality, developmental and social psychology, supported by biological psychology, research methods, statistics and ethics. Electives touch clinical, health, educational and organisational applications. Research field practicals in each subfield feed into the BA thesis, which gathers empirical work from those placements and is defended in the final exam. Small classes give a tutorial-like atmosphere. Graduates qualify as behaviour analysts supporting psychologists in educational, clinical, organisational and rehabilitation settings, work as HR or research assistants, or continue to a psychology master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Motivation letter and school records, then an entrance exam with its own fee. 2026 criteria; 2027 dates not yet published.

programmes.name: English and American Studies
programmes.about: English studies or American studies track, chosen after the first term: academic writing, English literature, British and American history and linguistics; does not give teaching qualifications.
programmes.overview: After the first term you pick an English or an American track. The English track covers English literature, British and American political culture, academic writing and spoken argument, and the linguistics of phonology and syntax. The American track concentrates on American history, culture and literature and the American variety of English, with an emphasis on critical thinking and research. Teaching is by lectures and seminars, and the degree does not give a teaching qualification. Graduates can continue to a master's in English or American studies or work in journalism, tourism, government bodies, diplomacy or private-school English teaching.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on school records and an online oral entrance exam about your motivation; B2 English needed. Three application rounds.
programmes.closesNote: Last of several rounds; applying early is safer.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Programming, software engineering and the mathematical and theoretical background of informatics, taught in English at the Faculty of Informatics in Budapest (180 ECTS).
programmes.overview: Mathematics and theoretical computer science sit at the centre, applied through programming languages and compilers, software technology, algorithms, data science and engineering, information systems, numerical analysis and computer algebra. Areas such as artificial intelligence, robotics, cryptography and cybersecurity are part of the picture. Teaching takes place in computer labs for AI, databases and robotics, with large team projects, peer mentoring from senior and PhD students, and optional undergraduate research under faculty supervision. Graduates work as programmers, software engineers and web developers in IT companies, banks, research institutes and universities.
programmes.ib: Good secondary grades, especially in Maths; online secondary-level Maths test, then an English interview if you score 75% or more.
programmes.selectionNote: School grades, especially Maths; online Maths test, and at 75% or more an English interview.

programmes.name: Applied Economics
programmes.about: General economics training with methodology and social, political and international applications, plus an introduction to other social sciences and business studies (180 ECTS).
programmes.overview: The course gives general economics training with a social, political and international slant: economic concepts, principles and theories, rigorous methodology, and an introduction to other social sciences and business studies. It looks at how individuals, firms and nations make strategic choices and at the political and social forces behind them, using deductive reasoning and mathematical models. The broad, general design is meant to keep career choices open. Graduates work as business, financial and market analysts or in marketing and sales, in government, NGOs, media and sport, or continue to a master's in economics, business, sociology or international relations.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on school records plus an online oral entrance exam, which you must pass; motivation letter of 1,500-4,000 characters.
programmes.closesNote: Last of several rounds; applying early is safer.

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: International politics, security studies, EU politics, ethnic conflict, global justice and human rights, with electives after a first year of social-science introductions (180 ECTS).
programmes.overview: You study international politics, security, EU politics, ethnic conflict, global justice and human rights, on a base of sociology, law and economics. The first year is made up of introductory courses, after which a wide range of elective seminars lets you shape your own path. Graduates work as foreign policy analysts, lobbyists, project coordinators or political advisers in public administration, NGOs, financial and commercial institutions and private firms, or they continue to a master's in international relations or another social science.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on school records plus an online oral entrance exam, which you must pass; motivation letter needed.
programmes.closesNote: Last of several rounds; applying early is safer.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: Mechanical engineers for machine design and production, using computer-aided engineering and Industry 4.0 technology; taught in English at ELTE's Szombathely campus (210 ECTS).
programmes.overview: Studied at the Savaria University Center in Szombathely, the course covers applied solid and fluid mechanics, computer-aided design and engineering, and finite element analysis, with production and manufacturing technology including Industry 4.0. Theory is paired with work in laboratories for materials science, production technology and control, which hold tensile testers, CNC machines and electron microscopes, and in computer labs running Ansys, Solid Edge, Inventor, ADAMS and Matlab. Graduates become design, production, automation or simulation engineers in manufacturing, vehicle production and research.
programmes.selectionNote: Good school grades, especially in Maths; a Teams interview with every applicant; motivation letter.

programmes.name: Kindergarten Education
programmes.about: Trains kindergarten educators for children aged 3-6: pedagogy theory, practical skills and planning of pre-school activities, taught in person in English in Budapest.
programmes.overview: The course combines psychology, pedagogy, methodology and language skills, with child development, differentiated lesson planning and activities for children aged three to six. Play-based education, a distinctive feature of Hungarian kindergartens, is central. The programme is practice-oriented, with a series of placements throughout the studies, and the faculty runs a Play Lab and workshops for educators. Graduates work as kindergarten or day-care teachers in municipal, church-run and private settings.
programmes.ib: Medical fitness statement and aptitude tests (English interview, singing, physical video); advanced English, B2, shown in the interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Four-part exam, all parts passed: professional test, English interview, singing and physical aptitude videos.

programmes.name: International Business Economics
programmes.about: Four-year economics and business degree in English at ELTE's Faculty of Economics: management, economic analysis and international trade, with law and social-science electives (240 ECTS).
programmes.overview: Year one covers management, marketing, accounting, mathematics, economics and business law basics, with an introduction to AI applications. Year two adds corporate finance, business statistics, international finance and economics, international political economy, taxation and marketing research, together with argumentation and persuasion. Later years bring leadership, international financial management, EU law and economics and negotiation, plus electives such as data analysis with Python and business ethics. Project work, one or two semesters of compulsory internship and a thesis make it practice-oriented. Graduates work as business development managers, economic analysts, consultants and trade specialists in international firms.
programmes.ib: Needs a full school-leaving diploma (two A-level-equivalent exams); English IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80, or an English-medium school certificate. IB results encouraged.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents screened, then a two-part online exam (written task, video, oral interview). 2026 criteria; 2027 dates not yet published.

programmes.name: Sociology
programmes.about: Sociology with project-based teaching, one semester of intensive project work and specialisations such as data analysis or criminology (180 ECTS).
programmes.overview: The programme trains professional sociologists in sociological concepts and research methods, and in recognising and interpreting social problems. Lectures and seminars are combined with project-based teaching, including a semester of intensive project work. You can add a specialisation such as data analysis or criminology, which carries an extra certificate. Graduates work in research, public administration, media, social and health services, marketing, HR and management, in roles such as community officer, social worker or marketing analyst, and can continue in social sciences at other European universities.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored on school records; a successful oral entrance exam is required and a lowest accepted score is set each year.
programmes.closesNote: Last of several rounds; applying early is safer.

programmes.name: Finance and Accounting
programmes.about: Finance and accounting with a general business-economics base, preparing for controller, audit and accountancy careers; taught in English at ELTE's Faculty of Economics (210 ECTS).
programmes.overview: The first two semesters cover management, marketing, accounting, mathematics, business law and economics. The next two bring corporate finance, controlling, international finance, taxation and business statistics, and later semesters turn to investment financing, international financial management and a two-semester project. The final semester combines a thesis with a compulsory internship. Electives include business law, social sciences and data analysis with Python. The degree gives exemptions from some ACCA exams. Graduates work as controllers, financial analysts, accountants, auditors, tax advisors and finance managers in multinational companies.
programmes.ib: Needs a full school-leaving diploma (two A-level-equivalent exams); English IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80, or an English-medium school certificate. IB results encouraged.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents screened, then a two-part online exam (written task, video, oral interview). 2026 criteria; 2027 dates not yet published.

programmes.name: Early Childhood Education
programmes.about: Prepares nursery educators for children aged 0-3: pedagogical competence and the cognitive and emotional development of the first three years, taught in English.
programmes.overview: The course prepares you to work with children from birth to three in nurseries, combining pedagogical competence and early-years methodology with a strong emphasis on practical training. You can follow a specialisation in Innovation in Early Childhood Education or in German Nationality Early Childhood Education, and a double-degree option with the University of Florence lets a few students spend their second year abroad. Graduates work as nursery educators in public and private institutions or as self-employed childcare providers.
programmes.ib: Health statement and an introduction video of 3-5 minutes; advanced English, B2, is assessed in the Teams interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Online professional entrance exam, English interview, and a 3-5 minute introduction video you record yourself.

programmes.name: Special Needs Education
programmes.about: Four-year degree for special needs teachers and therapists who support children and adults with disabilities, in English, at the Bárczi Gusztáv Faculty in Budapest (240 ECTS).
programmes.overview: The first semesters give a general introduction to special needs education and its related fields, including human biology, theory of education, psychology and the arts. From the third semester you specialise in one or two of four areas: hearing impairment, intellectual disability, visual impairment, or physical and multiple disabilities. Field visits run through the course, and the last semester is a professional practice period in an institution linked to your specialisation. Graduates work as early intervention specialists, special school teachers, inclusive education support teachers and rehabilitation instructors in education, healthcare and social services.
programmes.selectionNote: Online entrance exam with English tests: your motivation letter (250-300 words) and an oral interview.

programmes.name: Pedagogy
programmes.about: Learning and teaching across schools, adult and vocational education and civil society, with psychology, sociology and policy; final two semesters on digital education (180 ECTS).
programmes.overview: You study the education system, modern learning theories, research methods, psychology, history, philosophy and sociology of education, educational policy and digital education. Equal opportunities (inclusion, child protection, educational rights) and self-awareness and skills training are part of the core. The first four semesters give foundations and the last two focus on the Digital Education specialisation, covering educational technology and online learning management. Internships and projects take place in a range of educational institutions. Graduates work as educational developers, e-curriculum developers, digital educational assistants, project assistants and programme coordinators.
programmes.selectionNote: Motivation letter and school records, then an oral entrance exam in English. 2026 criteria; 2027 dates not yet published.

programmes.name: Chemistry
programmes.about: Research-oriented chemistry on a base of maths, physics and core chemical disciplines, with extensive lab work and modern instrumentation; a newly launched programme (180 ECTS).
programmes.overview: A research-oriented degree built on a strong foundation in mathematics, physics and the core chemical disciplines, giving you a theoretical understanding from the molecular to the macroscopic scale. Much of the learning is hands-on: extensive laboratory work, modern chemical instrumentation, data analysis and an introduction to academic research practice. Graduates can continue to a master's and PhD in chemistry or take entry-level jobs in chemical laboratories, analytical and quality control and research and development, including in materials science, environmental analysis, biotechnology and pharmaceuticals.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on school records and motivation letter; the page names no entrance test.

notes: ELTE shows one self-funded fee per degree on its application portal and no separate EU price; Hungarian-language and state-funded places run through Felvi, not these degrees.
Language degrees (German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Romanian, Dutch studies, Hungarian) are taught in that language or Hungarian, so they are left out.
Each faculty runs its own application rounds and deadlines, and later rounds carry a higher application fee; apply early.
